profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Instructure
profile.summary: I am a skilled engineer with six-plus years of experience. Currently, I am a Software Engineer at Instructure, working to improve the education experience for millions of learners around the world. I possess strong problem solving, collaboration, and communication skills, and have experience in both technical and non-technical leadership.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As an engineer on a Canvas core technology team, I help keep the most visited education website in the world available, reliable, and future-focused:
• Designed and implemented an automated feature release system, with
approval workflows and Jira + Slack integrations
• Led an org-wide effort to improve visibility into application errors and
performance — including tooling improvements & evangelism — resulting in a
noticeable improvement in incident response time and user experience
• Collaborated on the design/implementation of a new approval workflow in an
internal deployment tool, reducing the risk of ad-hoc changes
• Transitioned application secrets from flatfile storage to a more secure secret
management service
• Coordinated cross-team to drive initiatives aimed at deprecating legacy
technologies and practices, developing rollout plans to deploy safely at scale
• Provided mentorship to interns and colleagues, helping them grow in their
careers

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designing, as part of a small group of architects, system integrations for a complete transformation of the Six Flags POS and ERP systems
• Designing and implementing horizontally-scalable and highly-available MQ infrastructure using AWS services

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Led effort to utilize React.js and TypeScript in new frontend applications; researched tech and drove best practice adoption
• Collaborated with a small team to design system architecture of a new real-time, serverless attendance monitoring system (AWS Lambda, AWS Kinesis, AWS CDK)
• Designed and implemented a low-latency, browser-based video streaming solution for IoT cameras (Python, WebRTC, GStreamer)

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.locationName: Grand Prairie, Texas, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Led effort to implement Datadog monitoring into application ecosystem, improving system observability
• Integrated new filtering in targeted promotions system, increasing promotion flexibility by 40%
• Delivered performance improvements in account inquiry tool, greatly reducing search latency

positions.title: Managerial Supervisor
positions.description:
• Reverse-engineered Oculus code, and built companion Android application used internationally at Six Flags VR Coaster installations
• Built various automation tools using JavaScript, jQuery, VBA, and MS SQL

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: • Designed and implemented a specialty SaaS web application and licensed it to a Texas corporation
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · JavaScript · Ruby · Docker Swarm · Docker

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a new framework for in-game language translations, using crowd-sourcing to utilize the power of the community. Over 90% of strings available in 11 languages (Java)
• Re-designed complex permissions system for front-end website, improving system flexibility (Ruby on Rails, Redis, MongoDB)
• Delivered several new features for modular game experience (Java)
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Ruby · Redis · Java · MongoDB

positions.title: Student I.T. worker
positions.locationName: Lake Worth, Texas, United States · On-site
positions.description: Systematically stored, reinstalled, tested and configured classroom computer and media equipment during summer months.

projects.title: Lighting Designer - Lone Star Lights
projects.description: Returned for a second year to again design one of Six Flags Over Texas' most beloved Holiday in the Park traditions, the Lone Star Lights.

projects.title: Lighting Designer - Fa-la-la-la Light Show
projects.description: Completely re-imagined one of Six Flags Over Texas's most treasured Holiday in the Park traditions for 2016.
